title: Vehicle sounds and moving-screen distraction
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on cabin or startup sounds and, in one example, a screen interface seen as distracting while driving.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle's sound quality, welcome sound effects, and the lack of intrusive warning noises while driving.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the startup or entry sounds as awful, weird, or unnecessary, and one review says the large screen functions are distracting on the move.

limitations: This topic mixes at least two related but distinct subjects: vehicle sounds and a distracting screen interface while driving.
One negative example is too brief to identify the exact underlying issue beyond a strongly negative judgment.
The sample is small and stratified, so it may not capture the full range of experiences with these features.
